newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures mostly up on weaker yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures mostly up on weaker yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly firmer on Tuesday, as the yen's weaker tendency against the dollar stimulated sporadic short-covering by private investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen per kg lower to 1.0 yen firmer. Benchmark May ended up 1.0 yen at 144.0 yen.

After the market started steady to firmer, prices were trapped within tight ranges throughout the day. "The market is basically directionless as it lacked fresh incentives except for the currency market," one trader said.
